state.notice: This site is for information only. Applications are not accepted here: apply through eGov.kz, the Government for Citizens corporation or the archive's office.
state.title: Public service
state.intro: How to obtain an archival certificate, a copy of an archival document or an extract: conditions, time limits, documents and the official channels for applying.
state.law: Law of the Republic of Kazakhstan of 15 April 2013 No. 88-V “On Public Services”
state.rules: Rules for the provision of public services in the field of archives — Order of the Minister of Culture and Sports of 29 May 2020 No. 159
state.reportsPending: Reports are published by the archive. This section will be filled once the customer provides them.
state.contactsText: Questions about applying — call the reception:
state.translationNote: Unofficial translation. The official text is published on the Adilet portal.
state.serviceName: Issuing archival certificates, copies of archival documents or archival extracts

channels.title: Where to apply
channels.text: Choose the way that suits you. In every case the application is handled by the archive that holds the records.

egov.title: eGov.kz portal
egov.text: A request in the form of an electronic document signed with a digital signature. Copies of supporting documents are attached if available.
egov.hours: Around the clock. Applications filed at weekends are accepted on the next working day.

gov4c.title: Government for Citizens
gov4c.text: An application in the prescribed form and an identity document (or a digital document). The officer issues a receipt.
gov4c.hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00–18:00; duty offices until 20:00 and on Saturday 9:00–13:00.

office.title: Archive office or post
office.text: An application in the prescribed form and an identity document. By post — a free-form application with the applicant's details and the information needed for the search.

apply.title: Application
apply.text: Through the portal, Government for Citizens, the office or by post.

register.title: Registration
register.text: Within one working day; an application received after 17:30 is registered the next day.

check.title: Document check
check.text: Two working days. If the set is incomplete, two working days are given to correct it.

result.title: Result
result.text: A certificate, copy or extract, or a reasoned reply — within 11 working days.

documents.title: Documents required
documents.application: An application in the form of Appendix 1 to the Rules (on the portal — an electronic request with a digital signature).
documents.identity: An identity document or a digital document from the digital documents service.
documents.proxy: For a representative — a notarised power of attorney; for an organisation — a document confirming authority.
documents.supporting: If available — documents or copies confirming the requested information: employment record book, diploma, order.

tip.title: First check where the records are kept
tip.text: Find the organisation's fonds in the catalogue by its current or former name. In the application give the organisation's name, the position and the years of work or study — the search will be faster.

refusals.title: Grounds for refusal
refusals.invalid: The documents submitted, or the information in them, are unreliable.
refusals.requirements: The applicant or the materials submitted do not meet the requirements of Article 19-1 of the Law on Public Services.
refusals.consent: No consent to access restricted personal data required to provide the service.

other.title: Other services under these Rules
other.apostille: Apostille of archival certificates, copies and extracts issued by state archives and sent abroad.
other.export: Permission for the temporary export of National Archival Fonds documents from the Republic of Kazakhstan.
other.note: The conditions for these services are in Appendices 2 and 3 to Order No. 159.

state.checked: Checked against the official publication on the Adilet portal on 12 November 2026 (version as amended on 24 June 2026, No. 300-НҚ).
state.externalText: Applications for the service are filed on eGov.kz. Appeals, complaints and proposals go through e-Otinish. The links lead to external government portals.

index.title: Archive services
index.lead: What you can get from the archive and where it is handled. This site gives only the procedure, the documents and links to official services.

notice.title: This site takes no applications or payments
notice.text: There are no application, order or payment forms here. Applications are submitted through eGov.kz, the Government for Citizens corporation or the archive's office.

routes.title: What you need and where to go

certificate.title: Archival certificate, copy or extract
certificate.text: A public service: confirmation of employment, salary, studies and other facts from the archive's records. The procedure, time limits and list of documents are on the service page.
certificate.where: Free of charge. Apply on eGov.kz

paid.title: Paid services
paid.text: Work and services the archive performs under its price list. The approved price list is awaited from the archive.
paid.where: At the archive, under the price list

readingRoom.title: Working with documents in the reading room
readingRoom.text: Opening hours, how to prepare for a visit, and the rules. There is no booking or ordering of files on this site.

legal.title: Legal acts
legal.text: Laws and orders on archives, public services and personal data, with their status.

compliance.title: Compliance and anti-corruption
compliance.text: The compliance officer, the service's documents and how to report a violation.

external.title: Official services
external.text: The links lead to government portals and open in a new tab.

paid.title: Paid services
paid.lead: A reference page: which document sets the prices for the archive's services and where to check the cost. Nothing is ordered or paid for here.
paid.notice: Services cannot be ordered or paid for on this website. The information is provided for reference.

decree.title: Resolution approving the price list
decree.text: Prices for goods, work and services of the region's state archives are set by the resolution:
decree.name: “On approving the price list for goods (works, services) sold by the state archives of the Department of Digitalization and Archives of East Kazakhstan Region”
decree.pendingTitle: The text of the resolution is awaited from the archive
decree.pending: The materials handed over do not include the number, date or text of the resolution. Once the archive provides them, the requisites, the file and a link to the official publication will appear here.

price.title: Price list
price.text: Prices are published only from the approved price list.

table.caption: Price list of the archive's paid services
table.name: Service
table.pending: The approved price list is awaited from the archive. Until it arrives, no prices are published on this site.

ask.title: How to find out the cost now
ask.text: Call the archive's reception or write an e-mail: the staff will tell you the current price and how to pay.
